settings.downloads.resume.help.en: When a download is interrupted, keep what arrived and continue from there next time. 3dsDL only resumes when the server confirms the file has not changed.
settings.downloads.resume.help.zh: 下载中断时保留已接收内容，下次继续下载。只有服务器确认文件未改变时，3dsDL 才会继续传输。

settings.downloads.awake.help.en: Pause Sleep Mode while a download or install runs. Closing the system would otherwise turn Wi-Fi off and stop the transfer.
settings.downloads.awake.help.zh: 下载或安装时暂停休眠模式，否则合上主机可能关闭 Wi-Fi 并中断传输。

settings.downloads.zip.help.en: After a ZIP file finishes downloading, ask whether to extract it. Nothing is ever extracted without asking.
settings.downloads.zip.help.zh: ZIP 文件下载完成后询问是否解压。未经确认不会自动解压。

settings.downloads.cia.help.en: Choose what 3dsDL does when a CIA finishes downloading. Ask Each Time shows the icon and version before anything is installed.
settings.downloads.cia.help.zh: 选择 CIA 下载完成后的操作。每次询问会在安装前显示图标和版本。

settings.about.help.en: Version, credits and where 3dsDL keeps its files.
settings.about.help.zh: 版本、致谢以及 3dsDL 保存文件的位置。

settings.updates.help.en: Check for a newer 3dsDL and install it.

settings.downloads.help.en: Resuming, Sleep Mode, ZIP files and what happens after a CIA downloads.
settings.downloads.help.zh: 断点续传、休眠模式、ZIP 文件以及 CIA 下载完成后的操作。

settings.folder.help.en: The folder new downloads are saved to.
settings.folder.help.zh: 新下载文件保存到的目录。

settings.clock.help.en: Compare the console's clock with the time online and set it. Secure downloads fail when the date is wrong.
settings.clock.help.zh: 将主机时钟与网络时间比较并设置。日期错误会导致安全下载失败。

settings.other.help.en: Language, file sorting, hidden files, sounds, and download history.
settings.other.help.zh: 语言、文件排序、隐藏文件、音效和下载记录。

settings.language.help.en: Choose the language used for the 3dsDL interface.
settings.language.help.zh: 选择 3dsDL 界面使用的语言。

settings.sort.help.en: Folders always come first. Choose how files are sorted.
settings.sort.help.zh: 文件夹始终排在前面。选择文件的排序方式。

settings.hidden.help.en: Show files and folders whose names start with a dot.
settings.hidden.help.zh: 显示名称以点开头的文件和文件夹。

settings.sounds.help.en: Soft sounds when moving, choosing and going back, as in the system menus.
settings.sounds.help.zh: 移动、选择和返回时播放轻柔的系统菜单风格音效。

settings.sounds.unavailable_help.en: Sounds need the DSP firmware dump, sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc. Make it with DSP1, then start 3dsDL again.
settings.sounds.unavailable_help.zh: 音效需要 DSP 固件文件 sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc。请使用 DSP1 生成该文件，然后重新启动 3dsDL。

settings.history.help.en: Removes the list of past downloads and any partial downloads kept for resuming. Downloaded files stay.
settings.history.help.zh: 删除过往下载记录以及为断点续传保留的未完成文件。已下载完成的文件不会删除。
